analysis.summary: Return COM object Handle string when available; otherwise return input unchanged.

inputs.name: obj
inputs.meaning: Potential COM Dispatch object or any value

steps: Check whether obj has attribute Handle via hasattr
If hasattr returns true, return obj.Handle
If accessing Handle raises pythoncom.com_error, ignore and fall through

branches.when: hasattr(obj, "Handle") is true and no com_error

errors.case: pythoncom.com_error during hasattr or Handle access
errors.symptom: COM error thrown while probing Handle

side_effects: Accessing COM object's Handle property (may trigger COM call)

fields.meaning: Handle string if available, else original obj

examples.expect: Returns original object despite COM error
